summary: RELIANCE held at Quote and at Depth: an order book gives the Quote its best bid and ask; a book with no resting orders takes them off the Quote as it empties the Depth book (R107-06).

notes: The review's input: book.hex then book_empty.hex with both modes held.

deviations.reason: The web pads a short side of Nubra's book to five zero levels (price 0, an integer) Nubra never sent; the desktop sends the levels Nubra sent.
Nubra's order book carries the last traded quantity; the web drops it from the frames it builds on the book, the desktop keeps it (lost data).

The book has no asks after this message; the web sends ask 0, the desktop leaves the key out (a side the book does not have is not a price; R107-06, the review: omission is the authorized alternative to the zero).

The book has no bids after this message; the web sends bid 0, the desktop leaves the key out (a side the book does not have is not a price; R107-06, the review: omission is the authorized alternative to the zero).
